title: Corner Window Chips With Inline Actions
description: Replace the mode dock's separate right-side controls chip with per-tab inline actions (focus/maximize, new window, close) carrying localized tooltips and hotkeys, and give every window stack four corner tab groups (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right) with drag-between-corners, one active tab per stack — across the React, wgpu and TUI renderers plus the shared layout schema.
